title: Reinforcement Learning Basics
overview: Learn how agents improve behavior from reward feedback when the environment model is unknown.

method.title: Learning from rewards
method.body: The agent interacts with an environment and adjusts its policy to maximize cumulative reward.

method.title: Q-learning
method.body: Updates Q(s,a) toward r + gamma max Q(s',a'), an off-policy temporal-difference method.

method.title: Exploration
method.body: Strategies like epsilon-greedy balance trying new actions against using the best known one.

method.title: Deep RL
method.body: Neural networks approximate value functions or policies when state spaces are too large for tables.

pseudocode:
for episode in range(N):
    s = reset()
    while not done:
        a = epsilon_greedy(Q, s)
        s2, r, done = step(a)
        Q[s][a] += alpha * (r + gamma * max(Q[s2]) - Q[s][a])
        s = s2

playground.starterCode:
import random
random.seed(0)
Q = [[0.0, 0.0] for _ in range(4)]  # states 0..3, actions: 0=left 1=right
for _ in range(300):
    s = 0
    while s != 3:
        a = random.randint(0, 1)
        s2 = min(s+1, 3) if a == 1 else max(s-1, 0)
        r = 1 if s2 == 3 else 0
        Q[s][a] += 0.5 * (r + 0.9 * max(Q[s2]) - Q[s][a])
        s = s2
print(['right' if q[1] > q[0] else 'left' for q in Q[:3]])
